_comment: The chain of settlement sites from east to west. index orders them. region_west: the region an expedition from here travels. founded_at: the region whose boss must fall before this site can be settled.

fort_providence.name: Fort Providence
fort_providence.desc: Last real town before the edge of the map. Timber stockade, muddy streets, and every wagon heading west stops here first.

redwater_ford.name: Redwater Ford
redwater_ford.desc: Where Silas Crane used to charge a toll to cross. Now it's your crossing, and the canyons rise red to the west.

cloudbreak.name: Cloudbreak
cloudbreak.desc: Built in the shadow of Deadeye Mesa, where the Cyclops kept its flock. The mountains beyond are full of thunder.

sundown_landing.name: The Great Casino
sundown_landing.desc: Past the Titan's pass, lights blaze in the valley: the Great Casino, the paradise city at the end of the trail, where every chip on the frontier was minted and every fortune is waiting to be won.
